scenes.say: Zero point one seven one seconds split second and third at the first race on the Strip.
Leclerc passed Perez on the final lap at Turn fourteen. It was voted overtake of the year.
In the same race Ocon came from sixteenth to fourth, and Stroll from nineteenth to fifth.
In twenty twenty-five Antonelli started seventeenth, got a jump-start penalty, and still finished third.
Verstappen won that night by more than twenty seconds. That's the biggest margin on the Strip.
In nineteen eighty-one Vegas raced in the Caesars Palace car park. Piquet could barely leave his car, but won the title by a point.
Follow Saturday night's race on the LapRadar live map.

title: Las Vegas: 0.171 seconds, a charge from 17th and a title in a car park
